title: Allowing bigger value for history
line: The Color Picker widget has a new "History size" setting (up to 100 colors), and its history popup scrolls when it holds more than 9.
explanation: The Color Picker's history model hardcoded a maximum of 9 colors, so every newly picked color pushed the oldest one out for good, and the popup was a fixed 3x3 grid that could not show more. The change adds a historySize config entry (default 9, 1-100) with a "History size:" spin box in the widget's settings; the model uses it as its limit and trims (and saves) the history right away when the size is lowered. The popup's grid is now inside a Plasma ScrollView whose vertical scrollbar is on only when there are more than 9 colors, so the default layout is unchanged.

commits.message:
applets/colorpicker: make the history size configurable

The color history always kept only the last 9 colors, dropping the
oldest one whenever a new color was picked. Add a "History size" setting
(9 by default, up to 100) and let the history popup scroll when needed.
